criteria.criterion: A new key run.keep-awake (on, off; default on; VLOOP_RUN_KEEP_AWAKE); another value is a usage error on config set; config list and docs/guide/configuration.md show it.
criteria.evidence: internal/config/config.go adds the key with Valid on/off, default on; config tests and e2e list outputs updated; configuration.md row documents it and the env var

criteria.criterion: While on, vloop run holds a no-idle-sleep hold for its own lifetime: macOS `caffeinate -i -w <pid>` of vloop's own pid, Linux `systemd-inhibit --what=idle --why="vloop run" …` when available, Windows SetThreadExecutionState(ES_CONTINUOUS|ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED); the hold ends when vloop run exits, however it exits.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/keepawake.go KeepAwakeCommand and startHelper watch os.Getpid(); keepawake_windows.go calls SetThreadExecutionState with both flags; cli/run.go calls driver.KeepAwake after the lock

criteria.criterion: If the hold cannot be taken, run.log gets exactly one line `vloop: could not keep the machine awake (<reason>) — a sleeping machine stalls the run` and the run continues; with run.keep-awake = off no hold is attempted.
criteria.evidence: AwakeWarning builds the exact text; logged once, by the Planner when PlanOnly, otherwise by the Iterator; the error is only stored, never returned; KeepAwake is skipped when KeepAwake is false

criteria.criterion: docs/guide/concepts.md says what keep-awake does and that it does not cover closing a laptop's lid.
criteria.evidence: new section 'Keeping the machine awake' in concepts.md

criteria.criterion: Tests TestKeepAwakeCommands (the command each OS would run, as pure functions, on every OS), TestKeepAwakeOff and the macOS-only TestCaffeinateExitsWithWatchedProcess exist under internal/ and fail against the base; OS-specific code is in build-tagged files.
criteria.evidence: keepawake_test.go asserts exact argv per OS and off/on/error paths via seams; keepawake_darwin_test.go is tagged darwin and checks caffeinate exits with the watched process; osHold is split into keepawake_other.go (!windows) and keepawake_windows.go

notes: Only existing tests touched were the default-list expectations, which had to gain the new key. The warning's emission path in run.log is not covered by a dedicated test.
